Its value here is identity resolution: MAPENA (p. 51) = earlier 'Gwoira', villages Bemberi, Ruaba, source Dutton 1971a; whereas 'Gwoiru' (p. 31), 'Kanamara' (p. 37) and 'Tevi' (p. 69) are each 'Earlier reference to what is now regarded as part of GWEDENA' (= Umanakaina, uman1240; GWEDENA entry p. 30).
